reference_rule: Normalize reported daily mean levels using the minimum and maximum actually observed in 1970, within the same station datum. Not an operating range or a storage fraction.
measurement_timing: Official collection defines daily means. DATE is a calendar date, not a midnight reading or offset-aware instant. Historical daily clock is not established by this API response. UTC is used only as an internal date-axis anchor; timing_verified remains false.
discharge_boundary: 02LG006 is officially named GATINEAU (RIVIERE) EN AVAL DU BARRAGE MERCIER. Treat it as downstream Mercier gauge discharge, not a turbine-only series. Total Baskatong outlet completeness and Castor connectivity are unverified. 02LG007 DISCHARGE is retained separately and never assumed interchangeable.
vertical_datum: Use the station metadata returned by ECCC; no conversion to modern geodetic operating elevations is inferred.

operating_bounds.interpretation: Modern listed operating elevations; not overlaid on the historical arbitrary station datum

volume_mode: No storage curve or K; no volumetric storage or inflow estimates
attribution: Source: Environment and Climate Change Canada, HYDAT via MSC GeoMet; contributing agency identified in the saved station metadata.
reuse: Wateroffice permits copying/distribution with acknowledgement, excludes resale of bundled raw information and disclaims warranties. No ORRPB observations are accessed.
